slides.title: What did you want them *to understand?*
slides.sub: A question for after a rough conversation.

slides.title: Skip the replay
slides.body: After a hard talk, most of us replay who said what and who was wrong. Try a different question instead.

slides.title: Find the one thing
slides.body: Finish the sentence: "What I wanted them to understand was ___." One thing. Not the whole case.

slides.title: Did you say it?
slides.body: Look back honestly. Did you say that plainly? Or did it get lost in being right, being louder, or going quiet?

slides.title: Say it once, plainly
slides.body: If it never got said, you don't need a rematch. You need one clear sentence, when you're both calm.
